headline: 33 BGB platoons deployed across industrial hubs in Dhaka, Gazipur, Narayanganj
summary: The paramilitary force is on high alert to maintain order following garment worker protests over minimum wage demands.
details: Thirty-three platoons of Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) have been stationed across key industrial corridors in Dhaka, Gazipur, and Narayanganj.
The deployment follows recent unrest in the readymade garments sector, where workers staged demonstrations demanding a minimum monthly wage of Tk 30,000.
BGB troops are stationed in areas including Savar, Ashulia, and Mirpur in Dhaka; various points in Narayanganj; and multiple locations across Gazipur.
Field operations are being monitored in real-time via video feeds from a tech-supported surveillance room at BGB headquarters.
BGB personnel are operating on high alert alongside local administration and police to protect life, property, and supply chains.
Tensions have largely eased after the minimum wage board met on Nov 4, announcing a revised wage structure will take effect in December.
The revised wages will be reflected in workers' pay packets starting in January, ending the previous five-year wage cycle.
In the previous revision in 2023, the minimum wage for garment workers was increased by 56.25 percent, from Tk 8,000 to Tk 12,500.
caption:
33 BGB platoons deployed to secure industrial hubs. High alert remains as garment sector tensions linger.

Thirty-three platoons of Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) have been stationed across key industrial corridors in Dhaka, Gazipur, and Narayanganj.

The deployment follows recent unrest in the readymade garments sector, where workers staged demonstrations demanding a minimum monthly wage of Tk 30,000.

BGB troops are stationed in areas including Savar, Ashulia, and Mirpur in Dhaka; various points in Narayanganj; and multiple locations across Gazipur.

Field operations are being monitored in real-time via video feeds from a tech-supported surveillance room at BGB headquarters.

BGB personnel are operating on high alert alongside local administration and police to protect life, property, and supply chains.

Tensions have largely eased after the minimum wage board met on Nov 4, announcing a revised wage structure will take effect in December.

The revised wages will be reflected in workers' pay packets starting in January, ending the previous five-year wage cycle.

In the previous revision in 2023, the minimum wage for garment workers was increased by 56.25 percent, from Tk 8,000 to Tk 12,500.

headline: Tawhid Hridoy scores highest individual Test score for Bangladesh with 242
summary: The 25-year-old batsman achieved a double century, becoming the fourth Bangladeshi to do so, and led the team to a 30-run lead in the first innings.
details: Tawhid Hridoy scored an unbeaten 242 runs in the first innings of the Test match against the West Indies in Sylhet, setting a new record for the highest individual score by a Bangladeshi batsman in Test cricket.

Hridoy's innings was pivotal as Bangladesh was struggling at 22 for 2 when he came to the crease. He later helped the team recover, with the seventh wicket partnership of 184 runs, and eventually added 202 runs with Taijul Islam and Taskin Ahmed.

The 25-year-old became the fourth Bangladeshi player to score a double century in Test matches, and his score was the only significant contribution to the team's total, with Mushfiqur Rahim scoring 34.

caption:
A record-breaking 242 runs! Tawhid Hridoy has just rewritten the Test history books for Bangladesh.

Tawhid Hridoy scored an unbeaten 242 runs in the first innings of the Test match against the West Indies in Sylhet, setting a new record for the highest individual score by a Bangladeshi batsman in Test cricket.

Hridoy's innings was pivotal as Bangladesh was struggling at 22 for 2 when he came to the crease. He later helped the team recover, with the seventh wicket partnership of 184 runs, and eventually added 202 runs with Taijul Islam and Taskin Ahmed.

The 25-year-old became the fourth Bangladeshi player to score a double century in Test matches, and his score was the only significant contribution to the team's total, with Mushfiqur Rahim scoring 34.

Hridoy Hridoy described the achievement as a 'dream come true' and expressed gratitude for the        // Note: support from his teammates, specifically mentioning Taijul and Taskin for their confidence-boosting support.

When asked about his future goals, Hridoy stated that he currently has no specific targets, but aims to contribute to the team's needs based on the match situation regardless of the situation.

This was Hridoy's third Test match of his career.
